definition.name: 每日订单汇总
definition.description: 将已验证的「每日订单汇总」任务固化为可重复执行的本地数据处理应用：先写入订单 CSV 数据（默认使用记录中验证过的 5 行示例，可替换为自己的数据），再用 Python 逐行解析并以 Decimal 精确累加金额，生成 {"total": 金额总和, "count": 订单数} 格式的汇总报告 JSON，最后读回报告文件核对内容。全程仅处理当前会话沙箱内的文件，不访问网络、不涉及登录或验证码。

steps.title: 写入 orders.csv 订单数据文件

operation.source:
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

params = json.loads(os.environ.get("AUTOMATION_INPUT") or "{}")
csv_text = params["orders_csv"]
out_dir = Path(os.environ["AUTOMATION_OUTPUT_DIR"])
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
csv_path = out_dir / "orders.csv"
csv_path.write_text(csv_text, encoding="utf-8")
lines = [line for line in csv_text.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
print("订单数据文件已写入: " + str(csv_path))
print("数据行数: " + str(max(len(lines) - 1, 0)))

steps.title: 用 Decimal 累加金额并生成 report.json

operation.source:
import csv
import json
import os
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

out_dir = Path(os.environ["AUTOMATION_OUTPUT_DIR"])
csv_path = out_dir / "orders.csv"

total = Decimal("0")
count = 0

with csv_path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        total += Decimal(row["amount"].strip())
        count += 1

report = {"total": float(total), "count": count}
report_path = out_dir / "report.json"
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

print("订单数: " + str(count))
print("金额总和: " + str(total))
print("汇总报告: " + json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False))

steps.title: 读回 report.json 核对汇总结果

operation.source:
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

out_dir = Path(os.environ["AUTOMATION_OUTPUT_DIR"])
report_path = out_dir / "report.json"
content = report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
report = json.loads(content)
print(content.strip())
print("核对通过: total=" + str(report["total"]) + ", count=" + str(report["count"]))
